properties.description: Carga estados de resultados de silver.status a gold.dim_status. Clasificacion heuristica de estados para Tableau; validar categorias en vista previa.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId) AS status_id, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])), 80) AS status_description, CASE WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status]))) = \'finished\' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])) LIKE \'+% Lap%\' THEN \'Finished\' WHEN LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%accident%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%collision%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%spun off%\' THEN \'Accident\' WHEN LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%engine%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%gearbox%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%transmission%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%hydraulic%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%electrical%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%brake%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%suspension%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%clutch%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%overheat%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%mechanical%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%turbo%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%oil%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%fuel%\' THEN \'Mechanical\' ELSE \'Other\' END AS status_category, CAST(CASE WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status]))) = \'finished\' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])) LIKE \'+% Lap%\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS is_finished_flag FROM silver.status s WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_status g WHERE g.status_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId))',
